subject: Is it possible to reload the entire webpage?

messages.author: b56c9f6420f94aed
messages.subject: Is it possible to reload the entire webpage?
parts:
Is there a way to reload the webpage, in exactly the same way as clicking the refresh button in the the web browser or calling window.location.reload() in javascript, from server.R? 

I'm working on an application which currently displays a message to the user using validate(need(...)) if a table in a database does not exist. In addition to this message, I would like to reload the page automatically after a set interval of time.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Is it possible to reload the entire webpage?
parts: You'd have to use custom JavaScript or Dean Attali's shinyjs package to do it. But may I ask why you have to reload after a set time?
